# Research Brief: Route Mobile Limited (ROUTE.NS)

## Summary

Route Mobile reported its audited consolidated Q4 FY26 results on May 7, 2026 [1]. Revenue from operations in Q4 FY26 stood at ₹1,130.90 crore, down marginally from ₹1,175.00 crore in Q4 FY25, while net profit (PAT attributable to owners) rose to ₹109.32 crore from ₹56.58 crore in the year-ago quarter [1][13].

For the full fiscal year FY26, total revenue was ₹4,408.2 crore (₹44,082 million) [1][5]. The company’s CPaaS/non-SMS segment contributed approximately ₹3,500+ million (~8% of total revenue), growing 11% YoY; enterprise voice/SMS accounted for the balance (~92%) [5]. Domestic business and CPaaS drove most growth, while ILD volumes declined [5]. Full-year PAT for FY26 is **not available in this run**; only Q4 PAT was stated [1].

## Dividend

The Board declared a final dividend of **₹2 per share** for FY26, record date June 12, 2026, payable on or before June 26, 2026 [1][13]. Interim dividends paid during FY26 total **₹6 per share**, comprising:
- Q1 FY26 interim dividend of ₹3 per share [11]
- Second interim dividend of ₹3 per share [12]

Thus, the **total dividend per share for FY26 is ₹8** (₹3 + ₹3 + ₹2) — assembled from three distinct announcements [11][12][1].

- **Domestic vs. International revenue split**: Not precisely stated; only noted that ILD volumes declined [5].
